subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Hookshot across the broken bridge in the crater and break two red rocks blocking a cave to get the magic upgrade.

evidence.quote: hookshot across the broken bridge and you'll see two red rocks in the way...Break the rocks and go through to get the magic upgrade.

subject: Gold Skulltula 52
text: Smash the red rock against the left wall on the path up the mountain at night to find [GS052].

evidence.quote: smash the red rock up against the left...wall.  Make it night time and you'll see [GS052].

subject: Gold Skulltula 53
text: Break the red rock where the bomb flower was picked to open Dodongo's cavern to expose [GS053].

evidence.quote: where you picked the bomb flower as a kid to open up Dodongo's cavern and...break the red rock exposing [GS053].

subject: Gold Skulltula 54
text: In Dodongo's Cavern where baby Dodongos emerge, play the Scarecrow's Song to hookshot into a wall indent with [GS054].

evidence.quote: where the baby Dodongo's came out of the ground.  Play the...scarecrow's song and you'll be able to hookshot into an indent in the wall...with [GS054].

subject: Dodongo's Cavern Staircase Room
text: Take the raising platform to the second level of Dodongo's Cavern and return to the room with the lowered bomb flower staircase.

evidence.quote: Head back out into the main room and take the raising...platform to the second level and follow your original path backwards to...the room where you set off a chain reaction of bomb flowers to lower the...staircase.

subject: Gold Skulltula 55
text: Climb the vines on the staircase in Dodongo's Cavern to collect [GS055].

evidence.quote: it and collect [GS055]

subject: Mido
text: Play Saria's Song for Mido when he blocks the path in the Lost Woods so he will let you continue.

evidence.quote: Take the first let and you'll see Mido blocking the path.  Play...Saria's song and he'll move letting you continue

subject: Gold Skulltula 56
text: Ride the magic bean plant up to the ledge where [GS056] is sitting on the forest stage screen.

evidence.quote: Stand on the bean plant and...it'll raise you up to the ledge where [GS056] is sitting.

subject: Gold Skulltula 57
text: Hookshot to the scarecrow above the Sacred Forest Meadow maze to find [GS057] on the right wall.

evidence.quote: beginning of the maze play...the scarecrow's song.  Hookshot the scarecrow and you'll be on top of the...annoying maze...On the right wall...you'll see [GS057].

subject: Stalfos
text: Stalfos in the Forest Temple can be stunned during their normal swing or jump attack using Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: the hardest part would be the stalfos but with Deku...nuts it's a piece of cake, basically they have two attacks, a normal swing...and a jump attack.  You can stun them in the middle of either.

subject: Poe
text: Defeat Poes in the Forest Temple by pulling them in with the Hookshot and shooting them with the Bow as they run.

evidence.quote: for the poes shoot them with the...hookshot and pull them in, then as they run shoot them with the bow and...repeat when they appear again.

subject: Gold Skulltula 63
text: In Kokiri Forest at night, [GS063] is found on top of the house with two pillars.

evidence.quote: Make sure it's night time and walk out into the town, turn left as you walk...out and you'll find [GS063] on top of the house with two pillars on top.

subject: Gold Skulltula 64
text: At the horseback archery range at night, [GS064] is located on the far target.

evidence.quote: head up to the horse back archery range and go to the far target and you'll...see [GS064] on the target.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: Participate in horseback archery during daytime to collect [PoH26] and the first quiver upgrade.

evidence.quote: Make it day time and do the horseback archery...and collect [PoH26] and the first quiver upgrade.

subject: Horseback Archery Range
text: During horseback archery, shoot each of the 8 pots on the way down, shoot the big target while looping, hit three bull's-eyes on the way back, and shoot the last target.

evidence.quote: on the way down shoot each of the 8...pots, after hitting the eighth pot start shooting the big target at the end...as you loop around it, on the way pack put one in each of the three bull's...-eyes and unload the rest of your arrows into the last target.

subject: Gerudo's Fortress Chest
text: Hookshot to Pierre the scarecrow above the cooking pot room in Gerudo's Fortress to reach a treasure chest with [PoH27].

evidence.quote: Call the...scarecrow to the top and run around to where you jumped from to get the...token the first time through...On that platform...you'll find a treasure chest with [PoH27] inside.

subject: Gold Skulltula 65
text: Check behind the carpenter's tent at night to find [GS065] on the wall.

evidence.quote: go behind the carpenter’s tent at night time and on the wall you'll...find [GS065].

subject: Gold Skulltula 66
text: Find [GS066] on the stone pillar across from the entrance of the carpenter's tent.

evidence.quote: Go to the stone pillar across from the tent's entrance and...you'll find [GS066].

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course
text: Talk to Malon while riding Epona to compete in the obstacle course and win a cow for your house.

evidence.quote: Talk to Malon and she'll let you run an obstacle course...with Eponia to win a cow for your house.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch Obstacle Course
text: Do not use carrots on the smallest fences, replenish carrots every 6 seconds, and aim for a time of 50 seconds or less on the obstacle course.

evidence.quote: The course is rather simple you...don't need a carrot to jump the smallest fences...Remember to use carrots every 6 seconds if you need to replenish them...aiming for 50 or less.

subject: Big Poe
text: Steer Big Poes away from walls by moving toward the direction you want them to turn away from.

evidence.quote: Keep in mind you can steer them away from walls by moving toward the...direction you want them to go away from and they'll go away from you

subject: Big Poe 01
text: Ride past the tree near the steep hill by Gerudo Valley and up the hill to spawn and shoot Big Poe 01.

evidence.quote: 01.) Head to Gerudo valley area.  There's a tree near a steep hill, ride...past the tree (bumping into the right side) and up the hill.  Once you're...at the top use your remaining carrots and start shooting the poe.

subject: Big Poe 02
text: Ride across the path fork in front of Gerudo Valley straight toward Big Poe 02 so it will not sway into the wall.

evidence.quote: 02.) Turn around and ride across the path in front of Gerudo valley where...the path splits.  if you ride strait toward the poe he won't sway left or...right into the wall

subject: Big Poe 03
text: Back Epona into the land bridge near Kakariko Village to spawn Big Poe 03 and shoot it down before the fence.

evidence.quote: 03.) Go to the land bridge near Kakoriko village.  Back in with Eponia and...a poe will appear in front of you.  Take off after him and shoot him down...before you get to the fence.

subject: Big Poe 04
text: At the stream north of Hyrule Castle, back Epona into the far corner or ride through the bushes to spawn Big Poe 04.

evidence.quote: 04.) Go to the stream North of Hyrule castle.  Back Eponia into the corner...furthest from the castle.  If the poe appears take off after it, if not...ride forward hitting the bushes and it'll appear.

subject: Big Poe 05
text: Ride between the tree at the entrance of Lon Lon Ranch and the ranch itself to trigger Big Poe 05.

evidence.quote: 05.) Ride between the tree by the entrance to Lon Lon Ranch and the ranch...its self and a poe will appear

subject: Big Poe 06
text: Passing the corner of the stone wall toward Hyrule Castle causes Big Poe 06 to appear.

evidence.quote: 06.) Pass the corner of the stone wall (usually toward the castle) and a...poe will appear.

subject: Big Poe 07
text: Pass the lone silver rock near the stone wall to reveal Big Poe 07.

evidence.quote: 07.) Pass the lone silver rock near the stone wall and a poe will appear.

subject: Big Poe 08
text: Ride toward Lake Hylia through the woods next to Kokiri Forest and pass a center tree to spawn Big Poe 08.

evidence.quote: 08.) Ride toward Lake Hylia through the wooded area adjacent to Kokiri...Forest and as you pass one of the center trees a poe will appear.

subject: Big Poe 09
text: Ride through the middle of the bush patch outside the woods near Kokiri Forest to spawn Big Poe 09.

evidence.quote: 09.) On the out side of that wooded area ride through the middle of the...patch of bushes and a poe will appear.

subject: Big Poe 10
text: Ride past the sign directly in front of Hyrule Castle to spawn Big Poe 10.

evidence.quote: 10.) Ride past the sign directly in front of Hyrule castle and a poe will...appear.

subject: Ghost Shop
text: Turn in all 10 Big Poes for points to receive the fourth bottle and 500 rupees.

evidence.quote: I've caught all 10 and only used 20 arrows before...After exchanging the poes for...points on you card you'll get the fourth bottle (and if you don't spend any...money you'll have 500 rupees).

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Win the shooting gallery in Kakariko Village to obtain the biggest quiver.

evidence.quote: Now head to Kakoriko and play the shooting gallery to get the biggest...quiver

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Visit the House of Skulltula to receive [PoH28] as the final reward.

evidence.quote: Swing by the house...of Skullita and get your last reward [PoH28].

subject: Gold Skulltula 67
text: Ride the magic bean plant near the gossip stone at Zora's River at night to find [GS067] on the wall.

evidence.quote: Ride your bean plant to where the ladder is near the gossip stone on it's...own platform.  Make sure it's night time and on the wall closest to Hyrule...field you'll see [GS067].

subject: Gold Skulltula 68
text: Near the entrance to Zora's Domain where it starts snowing, look up and left to find [GS068] on the wall.

evidence.quote: Make your way up stream to the entrance to...Zora's domain.  As it starts snowing look up and to your left and you'll...see [GS068]

subject: Gold Skulltula 69
text: At Zora's Domain at night, stand at the waterfall edge to spot [GS069] on the wall to the left.

evidence.quote: Make sure it's night time when you go into Zora's domain and...go to the edge of the waterfall where you'll see [GS069] to your left on...the wall.

subject: Zora's Fountain Floating Ice
text: In Zora's Fountain where Lord Jabu-Jabu used to be, collect [PoH29] sitting on a piece of floating ice.

evidence.quote: Head into where Jabu Jabu used to be and you'll see [PoH29] on a...piece of floating ice.

subject: Ice Cavern
text: The Ice Cavern contains 1 Piece of Heart and 3 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote: The Ice Cavern is pretty simple there is one piece of heart and 3 Gold...Skullitas.

subject: Zora's Fountain Pool Bottom
text: Equip the Iron Boots to sink to the bottom of the pool in Zora's Fountain to obtain [PoH31].

evidence.quote: equip the iron boots and sink to the...bottom of the pool Lord Jabu Jabu used to be in and you'll find [PoH31].

subject: Lakeside Laboratory Roof
text: Ride the bean plant to the top of Lakeside Laboratory and climb the ladder to collect [PoH32].

evidence.quote: ride your plant to the...top of Lakeside Laboratory and climb the ladder to collect [PoH32].

subject: Fishing Pond
text: Catch the 19-21 pound middle fish at the Fishing Pond to receive the Golden Scale.

evidence.quote: Once there catch the middle...fish (19-21 pound fish) and collect the gold scale.

subject: Gold Skulltula 73
text: Sink to the bottom of the pool inside Lakeside Laboratory using Iron Boots to find [GS073] inside a crate.

evidence.quote: head back to the...Lakeside Laboratory and enter.  Put on the iron boots and sink to the...bottom of the water there where you'll find a crate with [GS073] inside.

subject: Water Temple Skulltulas
text: The Water Temple contains 5 Gold Skulltulas, 4 of which require the Longshot.

evidence.quote: As difficult as the Water Temple is known for being there are only 5 Gold...Skullitas.  Four of which require the longshot.

subject: Fire Arrow Platform
text: After obtaining the Longshot, shoot the sun, summon the scarecrow to the platform where the arrow landed, and Longshot to it to get the Fire Arrows early.

evidence.quote: After getting the longshot is your first available time to get the...fire arrows.  You don't have to complete the level just shoot the sun...walk down the ledge and...call the scarecrow to the platform where the arrow landed.  Now...longshot him.

subject: Lake Hylia Pedestal
text: Shoot an arrow at the sun from the pedestal next to the tree in Lake Hylia to make the Fire Arrows drop.

evidence.quote: when the scene...ends run to the pedestal next to the tree and shoot an arrow at the sun and...the fire arrows will drop.

subject: Gold Skulltula 79
text: Longshot onto the tree branch on the island in Lake Hylia at night to collect [GS079].

evidence.quote: go back to the tree and...longshot so you're standing on top of the one branch of the tree, now make...it night time and collect [GS079].

subject: Link
text: Arrive at Kakariko Village after completing the Water Temple to learn a new song.

evidence.quote: Make your way out and to Kakoriko...Village, when you get there you'll learn possible the most useful song...ever.

subject: Gold Skulltula 80
text: Inspect the back side of the fallen gate remains outside Ganon's Castle to find [GS080].

evidence.quote: before going into the temple of...time go to where Hyrule Castle used to be and you'll see Ganon's tower...Run to where the remains of the gate are laying down and on the back side...you'll see [GS080].

subject: Great Fairy's Fountain
text: Visit the Great Fairy Fountain at Hyrule Castle as Child Link to obtain Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: While you're at the Castle head in and get Din's fire (if you didn't...before)

subject: Gold Skulltula 81
text: Play the Song of Storms near the lone tree by the fence at Hyrule Castle to reveal a hole with [GS081].

evidence.quote: When you come out of the water on the far side of...the walkway you'll see a lone tree by the fence.  Play the Song of Storms...and a hole will appear with [GS081] inside.

subject: Windmill
text: Teach the Song of Storms to the musician inside the windmill in Kakariko Village to drain the well.

evidence.quote: warp to Kakoriko and head...into the windmill.  Teach the guy the Song of storms so he can teach it to...you in the future and the well will drain.
